objective: Verify that the protected action policy, isolated c1l expert router, and protected terminal worker compose into complete Prime Agent trajectories under the live split scaffold.

action_policy.label: adaptive-core-v1-e33
action_policy.responsibility: Choose only solve_owned, delegate_terminal, or delegate_coordinator.

expert_router.label: c1l-generic-anchor-step4
expert_router.responsibility: After delegate_terminal only, choose exactly one public expert_id from compact public evidence.

acceptance.complete_qualifying_definition: Every expected route is exact, the answer is exact, protocol and clean protocol pass, the trace stops as agent_completed, and delegated worker computation is model-authored.

decision_rule.if_passes: Admit the split scaffold and c1l as an experimental router component. Keep e33 and H176 protected; specialist-weight training remains a separate later experiment.
decision_rule.if_fails: Do not update weights or relax gates. Diagnose the first failing boundary from action, router, worker, or lifecycle provenance.
decision_rule.publication: No Hugging Face publication in this evaluation.
